When wlan interface is up
column2: 11d scan is sent to the firmware

column1: firmware needs to spend couple of seconds to complete the 11d scan. If
immediately a normal scan from user space arrives to ath11k
normal scan request is also sent to the firmware
event will be reported to ath11k until the 11d scan complete. When timed
out for the scan started in ath11k
column2: ath11k stops the normal scan and the

column1: firmware reports WMI_SCAN_EVENT_DEQUEUED to ath11k for the normal scan.
ath11k has no handler for the event and then timed out for the scan
completed in ath11k_scan_stop()
column2: and ath11k prints the following error

column1: message.
[ 1491.604750] ath11k_pci 0000:02:00.0: failed to receive scan abort comple: timed out
[ 1491.604756] ath11k_pci 0000:02:00.0: failed to stop scan: -110
[ 1491.604758] ath11k_pci 0000:02:00.0: failed to start hw scan: -110
Add a handler for WMI_SCAN_EVENT_DEQUEUED and then complete the scan to
get rid of the above error message.
